media.title: Max Kolpe (Max Colpet) — portrait graphic
media.altText: Grayscale profile drawing of an elderly Max Kolpe, also known as Max Colpet, wearing glasses.
media.publicCaption: Max Kolpe (Max Colpet), lyricist and screenwriter, in an unsigned portrait graphic reproduced in his book …wenn man trotzdem lacht.
media.publicCreditLine: Unsigned graphic reproduced in Max Colpet’s book …wenn man trotzdem lacht; via Claudia Karner, “Max Colpet im Porträt,” Deutsche Songtexte, 10 February 2016.
media.rightsNote: The source article identifies the graphic as reproduced from Max Colpet’s book but gives no artist, original date or reuse license. This reduced-resolution image is used for scholarly identification of a documented Kaper collaborator, with attribution and a link to the available provenance.
